messages:
emily: Quick question  flying into BOS late Wed, staying in Seaport. Need: 1) easy midday lunch near the office, 2) a nicer dinner for a client, 3) a grab-and-go spot by the convention center for a late-night dash to the airport. Any go-to recs?
ryan: Lunch: Flour Bakery for sandwiches or Tatte for salads/pastries. Both are quick and reliable.
devon: For client dinner, O Ya is a splurge but memorable, or try Row 34 if you want seafood in a more relaxed setting.
emily: perfect. Any late-night spots that actually stay open? worried about 10pm+ options.
ryan: Not many 24/7 in Seaport. Taqueria in the Financial District sometimes stays late (short uber). Also check Little Donkeyf09 for late service.
devon: For carryout by the convention center: Sweetgreen/CAVA are right there for fast bowls. If you want something local, Legal Sea Foods kiosk at the center is decent and fast.
emily: snack/coffee with plugs for a 90-min work sprint Wed morning?
ryan: District Hall cafe has plugs and open tables early. Blue Bottle's chill too but can fill up.
snackbot: FYI kitchen: Friday team lunch this week 12:30pm  pizza + salad :pizza: (not Boston logistics but marking your calendar).
emily: Amazing, thanks folks! If anyone has a dessert must (I have a short window Thurs eve), drop it here.
devon: North End cannolis are mandatory. If you like donuts, Blackbird or Duck Donuts are cute and portable.
emily: Saving this thread  appreciate the tips :heart:
